headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: Jay White wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event against Trent Beretta, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.63 ? a good, competitive contest. White's in-ring AEW debut, defeating a familiar interpromotional rival in Trent Beretta with the Blade Runner ? the first sign of what would become a much bigger AEW run for the former Bullet Club leader.

Turning the clock back to 2026: Swerve Strickland vs. Kenny Omega headlined Dynamite, rated 9.08 ? a war that left everything in the ring. Two former champions who'd circled each other for years finally collided one-on-one, Strickland needling Omega for being "nowhere to be found" while Swerve rose to the top.
That Wednesday in 2026, The Beast Mortos returned to the fold after 7 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2026, when it marked the first-ever meeting between Jon Moxley and Mark Davis, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 7.54 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
